=== Lead photograph (31 Oct 2026) ===
The lead is a crop of the woman in the Facebook profile circular. Exact legal name already on the wiki plus membership in the Star Wars CCG Facebook group (facebook.com/shelby.simonton). Gold 97 East Tuskaloosa, Alabama. The baby chalkboard photographs are not the person lead. Wiki File is the dest JPEG of the photograph. The File page Preserved copy is the Facebook profile screenshot. Identification stays on Talk. See [[:File:Shelby Abercrombie portrait.jpg]] and [[:File:Shelby Abercrombie Facebook portrait.jpg]].
